'''Marca''' was part of the ''[[FarStar]]'' crew during the search for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]]. During the attempt to defeat [[DarkStryder]] and Sarne, Marca was attacked by a [[Maoi]] that had been confined to sickbay.
